sahneler.metin: A US Navy minesweeper ran aground on Tubbataha Reef in the Philippines.
Within days it was declared lost, and it was later cut apart on the reef.
The crew used a digital chart.
It placed the reef miles from its real position.
The ship was dismantled on the reef.

aciklama:
USS Guardian ran aground on Tubbataha Reef. The cause: a chart error by the mapping agency plus crew failure to cross-check other charts.
